scenarios.setup: Submit task.json (workspace filled at submit); run generate→review→host-apply→post-apply-checks.
scenarios.expected: Independent review pass; post-apply check_widget.py exit 0 on the applied file; only target/widget.py differs from baseline; succeeded with full evidence.
evidence: host apply record per delivery contract

scenarios.setup: First model patch fixes ordering but renames the function (injected deviation, recorded with before/after hashes at run time).
scenarios.expected: Reviewer revises with evidence; bounded repair restores the name; re-review passes; v1/v2 artifacts and both bindings retained; succeeded.

scenarios.setup: Submit with max_turns=1 and a reviewer that always revises.
scenarios.expected: Terminal failed with a budget reason code; never succeeded; partial artifacts retained and queryable.

scenarios.setup: Worker adapter unavailable (fault injection offline; real outage if observed).
scenarios.expected: Controlled stop without success; error names the unavailable role; no invented artifact.

scenarios.setup: Worker returns a patch that is not parseable / violates the envelope schema.
scenarios.expected: Schema validation fails closed (needs_attention/failed); never treated as a valid patch.
evidence: no review binding on the bad payload

scenarios.setup: Cancel a non-terminal task via CLI.
scenarios.expected: Status cancelled with reason; later queries show the terminal state.

scenarios.setup: Host apply reports an unconfirmed write (simulated apply receipt marked uncertain).
scenarios.expected: Success gate blocks; needs_attention with explicit reconciliation steps; no silent success.
